planets.name: TOI-2445 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-2445 with a 0.371-day year, found in 2022.

text.card: TOI-2445 b was found in 2022 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around TOI-2445. Its orbit and size follow Giacalone et al. 2022's fit, the archive's default.
